title: Check yourself: Case facts, trimmed results and where a fact sits

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Scenario S1, customer support resolution agent. A refund agent condenses the conversation every ten turns. At turn forty the condensed text says only that the customer awaits "a refund soon"; the sum and the promised day from turn six are gone, and the agent quotes something else. Which change fits best?

options.text: Keep amounts, dates and statuses in a structured block on each request
options.says: The exact values leave the text that gets condensed, so no round of condensing can round them off.

options.text: Condense each fifth turn instead, so that less is rounded off in each round
options.says: Ruled out because "Each round compresses the previous summary, so a detail that survived once can be rounded off the next time", and more rounds means more rounding.

options.text: Ask the condensing prompt for longer summaries, with more detail kept in the prose
options.says: Ruled out because "A reader of the summary cannot tell that anything was lost", so more prose gives no check.

options.text: Send the full transcript on each request in place of the condensed text
options.says: Ruled out because "Resending the whole transcript is not the answer either".

questions.stem: Scenario S1, customer support resolution agent. A lookup returns 42 fields, and the agent needs five of them to decide on a return. After thirty lookups in one conversation, answers are slower and costlier. Which change fits best?

options.text: Move to a model with a bigger window so that all thirty results fit
options.says: Ruled out because the full result "is carried and paid for on every later request", whatever the window.

options.text: Cut each result to its first 500 characters before it is kept in the chat
options.says: Ruled out because the advice is to "trim by a list written for the decisions the agent makes, not by length".

options.text: Pass on the handful the decision uses, word for word, plus an id
options.says: The decision's fields are kept with their exact values and the rest is dropped before it accumulates.

options.text: Rewrite each result as one sentence of prose before it is kept in the chat
options.says: Ruled out because the fields are kept "with their exact values (never rounded or reworded)".

origin.section: Trim tool output before it accumulates
